announcement.title: Connection and provider improvements
announcement.description:
This update improves connection compatibility and private OpenCode startup, and shows clearer browser-extension errors in the desktop panel. After updating the browser extension, its chats also show detailed errors and new chats can use the default model from Settings → Preferences. Restricted hosted pairing links stay limited to their granted permissions and require the paired computer to be updated; their updated hosted pairing page rolls out separately.

Phones and tablets keep the Agents and Chats views, with saved conversations, drafts and preferences preserved. Desktop keeps Agents, Sessions and Chat.

Known issues: Hermes startup on Intel Macs, protected Claude cleanup on Windows and an intermittent Linux Antigravity startup stall remain under investigation. At the largest mobile text size, the no-model setup button can clip its label. Windows installers remain unsigned. Add to Chrome remains disabled until the Chrome Web Store listing is updated.
